entries.note: The merchant's order reached IQ Fulfillment's warehouse, which holds the goods; nothing is packed or handed over yet.
The order is being picked and packed in the warehouse. Some orders go from Order received straight to Shipped.
The packed order was handed to the delivery partner, whose name and number the tracker does not give; the parcel's first movement, not its delivery.
The delivery did not happen; its sentence gives no reason and asks the recipient to call IQ Fulfillment.
The order was cancelled before it was shipped, after Order received or Under process.
